caption:
Two little words, "given that," change your denominator.

Given that a student plays a sport, only the 75 athletes count, so P(senior) = 30/75 = 2/5, not 30/200.

Save this for your next probability question.
tiktok_caption: Two little words, "given that," change your denominator. Only the given group counts.

youtube.title: Conditional Probability: What Given That Means
youtube.description: In conditional probability, the group after "given that" becomes your denominator. Example: 30 of 75 athletes are seniors, so the probability is 2/5.
